current.text: He changed NBA teams this offseason and is now with Utah.
Utah's projected starters are Keyonte George, Darryn Peterson, Lauri Markkanen, Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic. Green is not in that group.
Utah's guard and wing group is crowded with George, Peterson, Sensabaugh, Ace Bailey, Markkanen and Jackson Jr., so there is little room for reserve wings.
Minutes and usage on Utah are expected to be all over the place early in the season.
Utah is expected to try to win and make the playoffs, so the late-season minutes a tanking team gives its reserves should not be there.

durable.text: Experts see him as a connective wing who adds size and depth, not as a good player.
He scores very little. Points are a league outlier on the weak side.

note: Green is not a draft option for us. Both sites value him at 0 USD and rank him outside the top 300 (334 on Yahoo, 319 on ESPN). His projections are about 4.6 points, 1.8 rebounds and 0.8 assists per game, and his only plus is low turnovers, which comes from low usage. He is a reserve on a crowded Utah team that is trying to win, so only check him on waivers if injuries to Utah's starting guards and wings give him real starter minutes.
